key_insight: Func-R1 tackles multimodal function reasoning by reducing visual-text interference, so the model learns to use both image cues and symbolic math more reliably.
engineering_relevance: The method is relevant for building MLLMs that must read plots, diagrams, and function graphs without losing mathematical correctness during reasoning.
method: Decoupled architecture separates visual perception from theoretical reasoning.
Hierarchical post-training first finds critical visual evidence, then deepens mathematical reasoning.
PATO aligns policy updates with theoretical properties while correcting visual information during inference/training.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive benchmark gains across diverse evaluations, including an 8.4% improvement over GPT-5 on MathVerse function-oriented tasks.
watch_item: Performance may depend on careful alignment between visual cues and theory, so the decoupled pipeline and PATO could add training complexity and sensitivity to implementation details.
paper_title: Func-R1: Incentivizing Mathematical Function Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
